purpose: Find the next Ink improvements; exploratory prototypes only, no production library edits in this review.
method: Cached native Blot compiler and Pen/Wasmtime fixture host; 8 warmups, 15 alternating paired samples; setup, guest work and complete output decoding included. Full output equality outside timers. Shared-guest committed memory is a high-water mark, not per-variant peak/RSS.

findings.title: Linear task-queue serialization
findings.change: Encode each job once into a chunk, then flatten once; preserve framing, full U32 tickets, callback order and mixed outcomes.
findings.limits: Measures serialization plus fixture construction and complete output decoding, not submit/settle/publish. Current submit/settle/publish storage merits separate batch/paged-queue measurement.

findings.title: Linear algebra for normalized change sets
findings.evidence: measured subtraction prototype; broader composition proposal unmeasured
findings.change: Merge sorted unique arrays for difference/union/composition instead of binary-searching each element and resorting concatenations. Preserve later-wins and removal-wins rules.
findings.limits: Probe uses equally sized sorted unique arrays, 16 subtraction passes. Public without currently accepts unsorted values; add a sorted internal path or explicitly change its contract. Highly unequal sizes need a binary-search/galloping fallback.

findings.title: SIMD validated packet decoding
findings.change: Validate four float lanes at once, then reconstruct four U32 words using shuffles and shifts; preserve framing, padding and malformed-input rejection.
findings.limits: Includes generating/packing input and complete output decoding. Scalar padding validation remains; gains for huge padding or tiny packets may differ.

findings.title: Sparse persistent scene/BVH updates
findings.change: Page scene proxies and BVH bounds so sparse changes copy affected pages and ancestors. Retain a dense buffer path for widespread changes.
findings.observation: At 65536 leaves, bounds contains 65536*12 F32 lanes: one sparse refit copies 3145728 bytes of payload before updating ancestors. Scene.update also copies every proxy.
findings.limits: Extra page indirection can hurt traversal and dense updates; benchmark both mixes with retained old snapshots.

findings.title: Direct any-hit and closest-hit BVH traversal
findings.change: Add direct any-hit/closest-hit traversals; stop at an accepted any-hit, visit nearer bounds first for closest-hit, and prune against the current best. Keep explicit source-index tie-breaking.
findings.observation: scene.cast/ray and point_solid currently obtain the entire source-sorted candidate array before narrow-phase testing; existence queries therefore cannot stop broad-phase collection early.
findings.limits: Do not change order-sensitive overlap/physics APIs; closest-hit pruning needs conservative bounds and exact tie tests.

findings.title: Prepared UI topology with explicit invalidation
findings.change: Prepare ID lookup, parent indices, child adjacency and traversal order once; retain them under a caller-owned topology revision. Recompute affected visibility/disabled/modal/focus state from explicit changes.
findings.observation: Every settle rebuilds parent lookup, performs repeated ancestor walks and reconstructs stop arrays, even when only values or text changed.
findings.limits: Requires missing-parent/cycle/depth semantics, modal focus restoration and cold reset coverage; benefit depends on UI size/reuse. Small trees should retain a simple path.

validation.prototype: Complete before/after output equality for every warmup/sample; sizes 0,1,3,4,5,65,257 plus measured sizes; independent Rust word witnesses through 4096 for all three prototypes; decoder every prefix and malformed values at every lane of a representative packet.
validation.currentLibrary: 259 Blot and 112 native tests pass in the actual working tree, including updated Pen bindings. No isolated fallback needed this time.

reproduction: Extract prototype.blot to .cache/next-ink-review/probe.blot and prototype.rustHarness to tools/native/examples/review_next.rs; run cargo run --manifest-path tools/native/Cargo.toml --example review_next (or append -- --verify-only). Run timing in isolation from other workloads.
limits: These are selected library microbenchmarks, not whole-game frame predictions.
Only findings 1-3 have measured replacements; findings 4-6 need prototypes.
Existing working-tree implementation and concurrent retained-rendering edits were preserved.
